title: Gil Martinez Jr. Begins Second Term on Laredo ISD Board
excerpt: Gilberto “Gil” Martinez Jr. was sworn in Nov. 19 as the Laredo ISD District 6 trustee, beginning a second term on the board, where he also serves as secretary.
content:
Gilberto “Gil” Martinez Jr. has begun a second term on the Laredo Independent School District Board of Trustees, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Martinez was sworn in on Wednesday, Nov. 19, 2026, as the trustee for District 6, the district said. The swearing-in took place at a special called meeting of the board, which also issued his certificate of election and administered the oath of office.

Martinez was first seated on the board after winning the District 6 seat in the Nov. 3, 2026, election, and the Nov. 19 meeting finalized his seating, according to the meeting agenda.

He also holds a leadership post on the board. When trustees reorganized after the election, Martinez was named board secretary, according to KGNS. Retired educator Veronica Orduño was elected board president, Juan Ramirez Jr. was named vice president, and Rodolfo “Rudy” Morales III was selected as parliamentarian.

Orduño, who represents District 3, and Goyo Lopez, who represents District 5, were sworn in for their seats on Nov. 17, the district said.

Sources:

  • Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 28, 2026
  • Laredo Independent School District, Nov. 20, 2026
  • KGNS, Nov. 18, 2026
